shortDescription: A Novartis AG drug billed as a potential blockbuster failed to cut the risk of heart attacks and strokes in a final-stage trial, according to Bloomberg. The result is a setback for the company’s new approach to preventing cardiovascular disease.

title: Novartis Heart Drug Misses Late-Stage Trial Goal
